objective: Characterize the minimum static rank for a proof whose every declaration has an eligible original factor; give a parameterized search and test variable-budget hardness on verified proof DAGs with live declarations.
status: Proved: The minimum static original factor rank of a supplied refutation is a represented Rank Vertex Cover optimum, computable up to rank r in O(2^r poly(N)) time. The unbounded-budget decision is NP-complete even for verified refutations of minimally unsatisfiable strict ternary formulas with all named products used as pivots.
title: Find a smallest original factor span
